preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if (i := line.strip() != '') and (i := int(line.split()[0])) if i % 2 == 0 else False)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the length of array A.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for x in A) and all(A.count(x) <= 2 for x in A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != ''] if line.split()[0] == str(N)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains N space-separated integers A_i (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^5), where each element appears at most twice in A.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == 2 * T and all(stdout.split()[2 * i] == str(max_hamming) and all(int(stdout.split()[2 * i + 1 + j]) in A for j in range(N)) for i in range(T) for max_hamming in [sum(1 for k in range(N) if A[k] != B[k])] for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != ''] if line.split()[0] == str(N) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2 * i].split()[0]) for i in range(T)] for B in [list(map(int, stdout.split()[2 * i + 1].split()))]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first output line is the maximum Hamming distance between A and any permutation B of A, and the second line is a valid permutation B that achieves this distance.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for k in range(N) if A[k] != B[k]) == max_hamming for i in range(T) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != ''] if line.split()[0] == str(N) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2 * i].split()[0]) for i in range(T)] for B in [list(map(int, stdout.split()[2 * i + 1].split()))] for max_hamming in [int(stdout.split()[2 * i])])
postconditions.description: The Hamming distance between A and B is exactly the maximum possible for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(B.count(x) == A.count(x) for x in set(A)) for i in range(T) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() != ''] if line.split()[0] == str(N) for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2 * i].split()[0]) for i in range(T)] for B in [list(map(int, stdout.split()[2 * i + 1].split()))])
postconditions.description: The array B is a permutation of A, meaning it contains the same elements with the same frequencies as A.
